name: Chief Minister's Free Cancer Chemotherapy Scheme
benefit: Medicine worth ₹10.00 lakhs per person per annum (₹5.00 lakh for 6 months).Free ConsultationFree counselingThe benefit of the scheme can be availed during the period of the entire treatment.
eligibility_rules: Regular State Government Employees and their dependents are eligible for the scheme.
documents_required: i.e. Aadhaar Card, Voter ID card, etc. Schedule Tribe Certificate for APST patientsTwo passport
how_to_apply: Mode: OfflineStep 01: The applicant may visit the nearest State Tertiary Cancer Centre and also contact the Nodal Officer for the scheme.Step 02: Application in the prescribed format may be received from the concerned State Tertiary Cancer Centre.Step 03: The applicant must ensure that the filled information should be correct before submitting the application form to the concerned department.Step 04: After successful verification, the applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme.
